# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from the ExperimentConfig dataclasses. Do not edit by hand: run `make docs-gen`. -->

One object configures a run: `ExperimentConfig`. Set fields in Python, or load a YAML
file with `ExperimentConfig.from_yaml(path)`; every run saves the config it used as
`<run_dir>/experiment_config.yaml`, which loads back to an identical config.
Unknown keys (typos, fields removed in later versions) are logged and ignored.

```python
from src.config.experiment import ExperimentConfig

cfg = ExperimentConfig(name="mes_h5")
cfg.data.data_path = "data/raw/MES_1m.parquet"
cfg.training.models = ["xgboost", "lstm"]
cfg.training.optuna.n_trials = 0
```

A `None` default on the barrier multipliers, `max_holding_bars`, `purge_bars`,
`embargo_bars` and `seq_len` means *derived*: barriers come from the per-symbol
barrier table, purge and embargo from the label span and the bar timeframe, the
sequence length from each model's contract (see [Concepts](concepts.md)).

## `ExperimentConfig (top level)`

Single source of truth for ML Factory experiment configuration. (`src.config.experiment.ExperimentConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `"ml_factory_experiment"` | Experiment name. |
| `description` | `str` | `""` | Free-text description (metadata, saved with the run) |
| `run_id` | `str` | timestamp + random suffix | Unique run identifier (auto-generated) |
| `output_dir` | `Path` | `experiments/runs` (+ `/<run_id>`) | Output directory for artifacts. |
| `random_seed` | `int` | `42` | Random seed for reproducibility. |
| `verbose` | `int` | `1` | Logging verbosity (0=silent, 1=info, 2=debug); MLFactory's default when its own ``verbose`` argument is omitted. |
| `data` | `DataSection` | see below | Data configuration section. See [`data`](#data). |
| `training` | `TrainingSection` | see below | Training configuration section. See [`training`](#training). |
| `evaluation` | `EvaluationSection` | see below | Evaluation configuration section. See [`evaluation`](#evaluation). |
| `bundling` | `BundlingSection` | see below | Bundling configuration section. See [`bundling`](#bundling). |

## `data`

Data-related configuration section. (`src.config.experiment.DataSection`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | `str` | `"MES"` | Contract symbol. Selects the barrier table, tick size/value, costs, session hours and ADX regime threshold (MES, MGC and MNQ have presets; other symbols use defaults). |
| `data_path` | `str \| Path \| None` | `None` | Raw OHLCV bars (parquet or csv) with a datetime index or column. |
| `start_date` | `str \| None` | `None` | Keep bars at or after this timestamp (UTC). |
| `end_date` | `str \| None` | `None` | Keep bars at or before this timestamp (UTC). |
| `bar_timeframe` | `str \| None` | `None` | Training bar timeframe. None = use the input bars as-is (auto-detected); e.g. "5min" resamples 1-minute input to 5-minute bars before features. |
| `features` | `FeatureConfig` | see below | Feature selection switch. See [`data.features`](#datafeatures). |
| `labeling` | `LabelingConfig` | see below | Triple-barrier labeling. See [`data.labeling`](#datalabeling). |
| `sequence` | `SequenceConfig` | see below | Sequence window for 3D/4D models. See [`data.sequence`](#datasequence). |
| `mtf` | `MTFConfig` | see below | Multi-timeframe features and 4D streams. See [`data.mtf`](#datamtf). |
| `splits` | `SplitConfig` | see below | Chronological train/val/test ratios. See [`data.splits`](#datasplits). |

## `data.features`

Feature configuration. (`src.config.data.FeatureConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection_enabled` | `bool` | `True` | Run train-only MDA feature selection per model. |

## `data.labeling`

Triple-barrier labeling configuration. (`src.config.data.LabelingConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upper_mult` | `float \| None` | `None` | Upper barrier multiplier in ATR units. None (default) means "auto": use the per-symbol/per-horizon BARRIER_PARAMS table, which is the same source the backtester uses — keeping labels and backtest playing the same game. Set explicitly to override both. |
| `lower_mult` | `float \| None` | `None` | Lower barrier multiplier (ATR units). None = auto, see upper_mult. |
| `atr_period` | `int` | `14` | ATR calculation period. |
| `max_holding_bars` | `int \| None` | `None` | Maximum holding period (time barrier, bars). None = auto from BARRIER_PARAMS, see upper_mult. |
| `binary_mode` | `bool` | `False` | Remap labels to {0: time-out, 1: barrier hit}. |

## `data.sequence`

Sequence-window configuration for 3D/4D models. (`src.config.data.SequenceConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seq_len` | `int \| None` | `None` | Window length (time steps per sample) for EVERY sequence model. None (default) gives each model its contract length (e.g. TCN 64, Transformer 128, most others 60). |

## `data.mtf`

Multi-timeframe feature configuration. (`src.config.data.MTFConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `bool` | `True` | Whether MTF features are computed. |
| `timeframes` | `list[str]` | `['5min', '15min', '60min']` | Higher timeframes to aggregate (also the streams fed to multi-stream 4D models) |

## `data.splits`

Chronological train/val/test split ratios. (`src.config.data.SplitConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `train_ratio` | `float` | `0.7` | Proportion for training. |
| `val_ratio` | `float` | `0.15` | Proportion for validation (calibration, early stopping) |
| `test_ratio` | `float` | `0.15` | Proportion held out for testing. |

## `training`

Training-related configuration section. (`src.config.experiment.TrainingSection`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `models` | `list[str]` | `['xgboost']` | Base models to train (any subset of the registered models). Choices: `catboost`, `gru`, `inceptiontime`, `itransformer`, `lightgbm`, `logistic`, `lstm`, `nbeats`, `patchtst`, `random_forest`, `resnet1d`, `svm`, `tcn`, `tft`, `transformer`, `xgboost`. |
| `horizons` | `list[int]` | `[5, 10, 15, 20]` | Label horizons. Each horizon keys the barrier table (k_up, k_down, max_bars); the first one drives the backtest and the default `label` column. |
| `training_mode` | `str` | `"standard"` | How models are trained and evaluated (see Concepts: walk-forward, regime, meta-labeling). Choices: `standard`, `walk_forward`, `regime_aware`, `meta_labeling`. |
| `cv_method` | `str` | `"purged_kfold"` | CV for hyperparameter tuning. OOF stacking always uses purged k-fold; `cpcv` makes the Optuna tuner score trials on CPCV paths. Choices: `purged_kfold`, `cpcv`, `walk_forward`, `pbo`, `standard`. |
| `n_splits` | `int` | `5` | Folds for purged k-fold (OOF predictions, tuning). |
| `purge_bars` | `int \| None` | `None` | Bars dropped before every test block. None = the longest label span (max_bars over the horizons); an explicit value shorter than that is raised to it. CV additionally purges on every label's actual end bar. |
| `embargo_bars` | `int \| None` | `None` | Bars dropped after every test block. None = one trading day of bars at the bar timeframe, capped at 25% of a CV fold. |
| `sample_weighting` | `str` | `"uniqueness"` | Default training sample weights: "uniqueness" (AFML average uniqueness of overlapping labels, from the training split) or "none" (all 1.0) Choices: `uniqueness`, `none`. |
| `walk_forward` | `WalkForwardConfig` | see below | Walk-forward windows (training_mode=walk_forward). See [`training.walk_forward`](#trainingwalk_forward). |
| `regime` | `RegimeSettings` | see below | Regime-aware mode (training_mode=regime_aware). See [`training.regime`](#trainingregime). |
| `meta_labeling` | `MetaLabelingSettings` | see below | Meta-labeling mode (training_mode=meta_labeling). See [`training.meta_labeling`](#trainingmeta_labeling). |
| `optuna` | `OptunaConfig` | see below | Hyperparameter tuning budget. See [`training.optuna`](#trainingoptuna). |
| `calibration` | `CalibrationConfig` | see below | Probability calibration. See [`training.calibration`](#trainingcalibration). |
| `batch_size` | `int` | `512` | Neural batch size (device is auto-detected per model). |
| `max_epochs` | `int` | `100` | Neural epoch budget (early stopping usually ends sooner). |
| `early_stopping_patience` | `int` | `15` | Epochs without validation improvement before stopping. |
| `build_ensemble` | `bool` | `True` | Stack the base models' OOF predictions with `meta_learner`. |
| `meta_learner` | `str` | `"ridge_meta"` | Stacking meta-learner. Choices: `calibrated_meta`, `mlp_meta`, `ridge_meta`, `voting_meta`, `xgboost_meta`. |

## `training.walk_forward`

Configuration for walk-forward training (training_mode="walk_forward"). (`src.config.cv.WalkForwardConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_windows` | `int` | `5` | Number of walk-forward windows. |
| `window_type` | `str` | `"expanding"` | 'expanding' (growing train) or 'rolling' (fixed train) Choices: `expanding`, `rolling`. |
| `min_train_pct` | `float` | `0.4` | Fraction of data in the first training window. |
| `test_pct` | `float` | `0.1` | Fraction of data per test window. |

## `training.regime`

Regime-aware mode (training_mode="regime_aware"): one model per market regime. (`src.config.experiment.RegimeSettings`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detection_method` | `str` | `"volatility_percentile"` | Rolling statistic that assigns each bar a regime. Choices: `volatility_percentile`, `trend_adx`, `combined`. |
| `n_regimes` | `int` | `3` | 2 = low/high, 3 = low/medium/high. Choices: `2`, `3`. |
| `lookback` | `int` | `60` | bars of history for the rolling regime statistic. |

## `training.meta_labeling`

Meta-labeling mode (training_mode="meta_labeling"). (`src.config.experiment.MetaLabelingSettings`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta_model` | `str` | `"logistic"` | Classifier that learns P(the primary's bet pays off). The primary model is `training.models[0]`. Choices: `logistic`, `random_forest`, `xgboost`, `lightgbm`, `catboost`. |
| `threshold` | `float` | `0.5` | Take a primary bet only when the meta-model's P(bet pays off) is at least this. |

## `training.optuna`

Optuna hyperparameter optimization budget. (`src.config.training.OptunaConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `n_trials` | `int` | `100` | Trials per model (0 disables hyperparameter tuning) |
| `timeout` | `int` | `43200` | Wall-clock cap per study in seconds (0 = no timeout) |
| `metric` | `str` | `"f1_weighted"` | Objective the tuner maximizes. Choices: `f1_weighted`, `accuracy`, `sharpe_ratio`, `sortino_ratio`, `profit_factor`, `precision`, `recall`, `roc_auc`, `log_loss`. |

## `training.calibration`

Post-training probability calibration. (`src.config.training.CalibrationConfig`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `bool` | `True` | Whether calibration is fitted. |
| `method` | `str` | `"auto"` | 'auto', 'isotonic' or 'sigmoid' (Platt) Choices: `auto`, `isotonic`, `sigmoid`. |

## `evaluation`

Evaluation-related configuration section. (`src.config.experiment.EvaluationSection`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_backtest` | `bool` | `False` | Backtest the deployed strategy's out-of-sample signals. |
| `position_sizing` | `str` | `"fixed"` | Backtest sizing: `fixed` (fixed contracts), `volatility` (volatility targeted), `confidence` (bet sizing from model confidence), `kelly`. Choices: `fixed`, `volatility`, `confidence`, `kelly`. |
| `commission_per_contract` | `float \| None` | `None` | Override the round-trip commission per contract (dollars; exchange and NFA fees are added on top). |
| `slippage_ticks` | `float \| None` | `None` | Override the slippage per fill (ticks, one way). |
| `initial_equity` | `float` | `100000.0` | Starting equity of the backtest (dollars). |

## `bundling`

Bundling-related configuration section. (`src.config.experiment.BundlingSection`)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create_bundle` | `bool` | `True` | Write one inference bundle per model (and ensemble) per horizon. |
| `deploy_artifact` | `bool` | `True` | Write `deploy/manifest.json` indexing the bundles. |

## Full default config as YAML

`ExperimentConfig().save_yaml(path)` writes this (plus `run_id` and `output_dir`):

```yaml
name: ml_factory_experiment
description: ''
random_seed: 42
verbose: 1
data:
  symbol: MES
  data_path: null
  start_date: null
  end_date: null
  bar_timeframe: null
  features:
    selection_enabled: true
  labeling:
    upper_mult: null
    lower_mult: null
    atr_period: 14
    max_holding_bars: null
    binary_mode: false
  sequence:
    seq_len: null
  mtf:
    enabled: true
    timeframes:
    - 5min
    - 15min
    - 60min
  splits:
    train_ratio: 0.7
    val_ratio: 0.15
    test_ratio: 0.15
training:
  models:
  - xgboost
  horizons:
  - 5
  - 10
  - 15
  - 20
  training_mode: standard
  cv_method: purged_kfold
  n_splits: 5
  purge_bars: null
  embargo_bars: null
  sample_weighting: uniqueness
  walk_forward:
    n_windows: 5
    window_type: expanding
    min_train_pct: 0.4
    test_pct: 0.1
  regime:
    detection_method: volatility_percentile
    n_regimes: 3
    lookback: 60
  meta_labeling:
    meta_model: logistic
    threshold: 0.5
  optuna:
    n_trials: 100
    timeout: 43200
    metric: f1_weighted
  calibration:
    enabled: true
    method: auto
  batch_size: 512
  max_epochs: 100
  early_stopping_patience: 15
  build_ensemble: true
  meta_learner: ridge_meta
evaluation:
  run_backtest: false
  position_sizing: fixed
  commission_per_contract: null
  slippage_ticks: null
  initial_equity: 100000.0
bundling:
  create_bundle: true
  deploy_artifact: true
```
